comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This trunk would've been awarded during a special pre-2nd Age launch event... unfortunately, right before that event was scheduled to begin, NetMarble (who hosted UWO previously and had advertised the event as 'coming soon') went out of business.

OGP took over hosting duties, but they skipped over the event for reasons unknown, thus this item remains unreleased. OGP also skipped a pre-Gran Atlas event we should've had with rare items/crests, for equally unknown reasons, sadly. Oh well.

The contents of this box -- uniquely colored clothing items with mostly mediocre stats -- have rarely been released in bottles, but otherwise, remain impossible to acquire. You can see them all here:

rabbilog.blog46.fc2.com/blog-entry-209.html

Maybe for posterity's sake, links to them should be added here on the DB at some point, too.
